_note: Baselines for scripts/regression_check.py. `expect` is computed by regression_check.metrics() over the file named in `source`, so the two cannot disagree. This is not a pass/fail bar -- PLAN.md section 9 rejected arrival as one. It records what was measured so a later run that moves can be noticed.
_caveat_no_route_frames: Runs recorded before 2026-09-22 count `no_route_frames` as routing failures only. From the route-anchor fix onward they also count junction transits, reported separately as `internal_edge_frames`. The two are not directly comparable across that boundary.
_caveat_closed_route_m: Runs recorded before de4d8e2 (2026-09-23) seed `closed_route_m` from the spawn's lookup edge: at a junction origin, whichever normal edge `_road_edge_near` finds first clockwise from north, not necessarily the one the fly drives. On the 500 m route that inflated every episode's closure by ~123 m; on the twisty route the two edges coincide. From de4d8e2 the seed settles on the first edge the moving fly is on. Not comparable across that boundary.
